firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently visited Catalonia receives the first-player marker and takes the first turn.
clarifications: Players take turns clockwise. At the end of each round except the last, pass the first-player marker to the left for the next round.

internalEvidence: Rendered pages 5 and 6 (printed pages 4 and 5) of the Renegade-authored English rulebook. Final Steps assigns the marker to the most recent visitor to Catalonia; Round Structure defines clockwise turns and leftward marker transfer. A university-hosted copy preserves the publisher rulebook. SHA-256: 7efc514fa2d6e784d30713542bffabd9f03a23ceb907ea4391025d5747dcc2cc. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-23: Rechecked the cited starter instruction and edition attribution.
uncertainty: The rulebook gives no tie-break for equally recent visits to Catalonia.
